title: Warrants, dinosaur bones, and resolving conjectures with AI
author: Joseph Tooby-Smith

metaphors.title: Dinosaur bones in the field
metaphors.paraphrase: Finding a warrant for a conjecture is like digging in a field and hitting a dinosaur bone: partly luck, and AI can hand you fun-shaped rocks instead; careless digging may destroy the evidence of why the bone was there.
metaphors.style_hint: An excavation pit with a skeleton and a few suspicious rocks.

metaphors.title: A digger and a dumpster truck
metaphors.paraphrase: Using AI is hiring a digger and a dumpster truck to move more dirt: better odds of a find, at a cost in money and judgment.
metaphors.style_hint: An excavator beside a dumpster truck.
